Hyundai has updated the Ioniq 5, and the biggest talking point is its larger 84kWh battery. But in the process, this value-focused EV has become one of the most expensive options available. Tesla, meanwhile, has dropped prices of the Model Y. With the pricing hierarchy flipped, Saumil Shah compares these two EVs to find out which is better.
Editor: Mohit Sharma
